bc84a9d3b7ff.text: Clear definitions for the science, engineering and decisions behind AeroSense.

b46176e32d17.text: Odorant receptor co-receptor — an insect co-receptor that partners with ORs to form ligand-gated ion channels.

d22652b1c3d0.text: Start with a term. Follow the connections.

ee06a436ca27.text: Analog-to-digital converter — hardware that samples an analog voltage and encodes it as a digital value.

c28efe4961ec.text: A family of mycotoxins produced by some Aspergillus fungi. Detecting an odor associated with a fungus does not measure toxin concentration.

07a87871c676.text: Antennal lobe — the insect brain center that receives primary olfactory input and performs early odor processing.

27ef44969ff0.text: Air–liquid interface — a culture or sampling setup where cells contact gas above a liquid medium.

1eda54234e13.text: A statistical score comparing variation between groups with variation within groups; used here as one feature-ranking check.

66cca663ed77.text: Business-to-business: a product or service sold to an organization rather than directly to individual consumers.

c75deb07715c.text: A simple comparison method used to judge whether a more complex model actually adds value.

403a80811f29.text: The first narrowly defined customer group and use case a team chooses to test before expanding.

432663dc9cff.text: A standardized genetic part format used in iGEM and related registries for modular DNA assembly.

ef1d78cecc57.text: Bill of materials — the list of parts, quantities, and specifications needed to build a device.

5f7db9e89b5a.text: A type IIS restriction enzyme used in some DNA assembly workflows; an internal site can interfere with that assembly method.

fe291f56af15.text: Biosafety level — a set of containment practices and facilities matched to the organisms and procedures in a laboratory.

c74a699dd994.text: Computer-aided design — the digital geometry and drawings used to describe and revise a physical part.

73db1f7b3769.text: Comparing an instrument with a known reference so its response can be interpreted or corrected.

6fd411a75b01.text: Coding sequence — the DNA segment whose information is translated into a protein.

63141c73c65e.text: Computational fluid dynamics — numerical calculations of fluid motion, used here to compare airflow and pressure through the reader.

f778268c3775.text: A signal exceeding the usable measurement range and being cut off at a limit. Background subtraction cannot recover the missing signal.

dbc8d48e2f44.text: A promoter derived from cytomegalovirus that is commonly used to drive gene expression in mammalian cells.

5aae009da7a6.text: Changing a gene's DNA codons while preserving its protein sequence, often to suit the expression host.

888282a5882b.text: A genetic construct assembled from multiple functional DNA elements to perform a defined role.

bbe5228c44c9.text: A follow-up test using an appropriate validated method to investigate a screening signal.

fdb0df5a771f.text: A table comparing predicted classes with reference labels, including correct and incorrect decisions.

24523d1e052d.text: Signal from one channel appearing in another. In the four-well reader, optical mixing can remain even after frequency-selective processing.

52ac21038409.text: Evaluating a model across multiple training/test splits to estimate how it performs on unseen data.

8e7c468211f1.text: Electrical output from a light-detection system even when no intended light reaches its sensor.

b41b0c16ee90.text: Information from the test set enters model training, making performance appear better than it would be on truly new data.

f1fef4b14bd4.text: Design → Build → Test → Learn → Redesign: a cycle that records a decision, its test, what was learned, and the next change.

46147c8c338a.text: Direct digital synthesis — generating a periodic waveform using a digital phase accumulator and a reference clock.

2d3be687ac6c.text: The lowest signal or concentration that a specified method can reliably distinguish from its blank under stated conditions.

7932364418a8.text: Digital lock-in amplifier — a digital method that extracts a signal at a known reference frequency while rejecting other noise.

24b02d6e3a75.text: Design-rule check — software checks whether a PCB layout follows specified spacing and manufacturing rules.

61d6bccd6332.text: A genus of flies. The fruit fly Drosophila melanogaster is a source of well-studied odorant receptors and inspired the project's sensing and coding designs.

7b23df11b47e.text: An instrument that combines chemical sensors and pattern analysis to distinguish odor mixtures.

91c4e95e4f09.text: Exponential moving average — a display smoothing method that gives more weight to recent values. Smoothing does not remove systematic measurement error.

59f5debdfcb0.text: An internal ribosome entry site derived from encephalomyocarditis virus, used to translate a downstream protein from the same mRNA.

15837d008b21.text: Electrical-rule check — software checks for possible connection mistakes in a circuit schematic.

25f44782bb81.text: A family of microcontrollers that can control electronics and process data on a compact board.

45690df6e16e.text: Light used to stimulate a fluorescent reporter; it must be separated from the weaker light emitted by the reporter.

f7d238477e96.text: A classification score combining precision and recall. Its meaning depends on the dataset and evaluation split.

bbaf0d60bf1c.text: A test misses a problem that the reference condition says is present.

79c88b058d4c.text: A test flags a problem when the reference condition says that problem is absent.

3964e5b4c6c4.text: Frequency-division multiplexing — assigning distinct carrier frequencies so multiple optical channels can share a detector path.

a616c124c07c.text: Taiwan's From IP to IPO innovation and entrepreneurship program, which provided business-plan and pitch feedback to the team.

8d483844df78.text: Light emitted by a molecule after it absorbs light at another wavelength. AeroSense uses a calcium-sensitive fluorescent reporter in its sensing design.

3fb2bb65de9f.text: The ratio of emitted fluorescence photons to absorbed excitation photons. It describes emission efficiency, not how much light the detector collects.

99ea29354df6.text: An antibiotic used to select mammalian cells carrying a compatible resistance gene.

3a077ec7068c.text: Gas chromatography–mass spectrometry — a laboratory method that separates volatile compounds and helps identify them by mass.

9bc875c2a91c.text: A family of genetically encoded fluorescent reporters that become brighter when calcium inside a cell rises.

97084b5f3be0.text: A genetically encoded fluorescent calcium indicator used to report intracellular Ca²⁺ changes.

ca30dfbcf3c8.text: General-purpose input/output — programmable microcontroller pins that read or drive digital signals.

f3a9d158778e.text: The gas above a liquid or solid sample; volatile molecules from the sample may enter this space.

8e92ba0488aa.text: A human cell line derived from embryonic kidney culture and transformed with adenovirus 5 DNA. HEK293 is the host used for the team’s heterologous receptor-expression experiments.

e70b4fc729f3.text: A large opposition to current flow. In a photodiode receiver, high-impedance input nodes require careful layout because small leakage currents can interfere with the measured signal.

881f4f69652d.text: Comparing a measured signal with two reference waves separated by a quarter cycle. Their in-phase and quadrature components describe the signal's amplitude and phase at a selected frequency.

3aabf6b82ff0.text: The shared database where teams document biological parts, including their identity, sequence, and characterization.

3966e315b468.text: A volatile organic compound that can occur in microbial metabolism; a signal of indole alone cannot identify a pathogen.

519bd705a67b.text: The way stakeholder input changes a project's choices throughout development, with the change and its evidence documented.

dac668e13fa1.text: A compound that raises intracellular calcium and can test whether a calcium reporter responds independently of the odorant-receptor channel.

ce05ac3cecc7.text: Institutional Review Board — a body that reviews certain research involving human participants; whether review is required depends on the activity and local rules.

61a7a5cae16a.text: Internal ribosome entry site — an RNA element that can initiate translation of a downstream open reading frame independently of the 5′ cap.

87434c939d1d.text: An international standard for the competence of testing and calibration laboratories. A future certification goal is not current accreditation.

b0b00669ffcb.text: Kenyon cell — a mushroom-body neuron that typically participates in sparse, high-dimensional odor representations.

069e943cd5cc.text: Open-source software for designing circuit schematics and printed circuit boards.

81398a39e96a.text: A short sequence around a start codon that helps a mammalian ribosome begin protein translation.

9129d608a6f5.text: A circuit motif in which active units suppress neighbors, often increasing contrast between signals.

220d3bbd9cb8.text: Liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry — a laboratory method that separates compounds in a liquid sample and analyzes their masses.

d8722990a811.text: Low-dropout regulator — a circuit that maintains a regulated supply voltage with a small required voltage difference between input and output.

f671bd233f1d.text: Light-emitting diode — a semiconductor light source. In the reader, blue excitation light stimulates a fluorescent response; it is not the fluorescence signal itself.

26363d3271e6.text: A method for estimating environmental impacts across a product's materials, manufacture, use, and disposal.

70642cdbde72.text: Letter of intent — a written statement that an organization is interested in a defined next step; it is not the same as a purchase.

d96717226416.text: Leave-one-sensor-out analysis — remove one sensor at a time and see how a model's performance changes.

2c1461d305fe.text: Locality-sensitive hashing — a method that maps similar inputs to nearby codes with high probability.

947ee08db33d.text: Mushroom body — an insect brain structure involved in olfactory learning, memory, and sparse odor coding.

0eeb3186b52a.text: Mushroom body output neuron — a neuron that reads mushroom-body activity and contributes to behavioral decisions.

21e35234852a.text: A red fluorescent protein used here as an expression marker; it is distinct from the calcium-sensitive sensing readout.

2a645c3b4c76.text: Microcontroller unit — a small computer on a chip that coordinates electronics, timing, and data acquisition.

5dbc7a0e3fb8.text: A numerical method that follows many randomly sampled events. In the optical model, simulated photon paths estimate how much light reaches the detector.

d59b28637e5f.text: Minimum viable product — the smallest usable product that can test a specific customer need.

d41ca28978b9.text: A toxic secondary metabolite that some fungi can produce. Detecting mold growth is not the same measurement as quantifying a mycotoxin.

89c3db8e0699.text: A gene giving resistance to neomycin-family selection drugs such as G418, used to select cells carrying an expression vector.

1ca835364c2b.text: Odorant-binding protein — a soluble protein that can bind and help transport hydrophobic odorants.

6f98802f9d9e.text: An insect receptor protein that helps turn binding by an odor molecule into a cellular signal, usually in partnership with Orco.

76652960c3d5.text: Light energy incident per unit area, integrated over time. In a steady optical calculation, the corresponding fluence rate describes light power per unit area arriving from all directions.

6b73b31a4c07.text: A fruit-fly odorant receptor considered in the project's receptor library for indole-related sensing research.

b8891c8c4949.text: A coordinated set of biological parts with a clear purpose and documentation showing how the parts work together.

4bbf8aaed703.text: Principal component analysis — a method that summarizes variation in many measurements using a smaller set of combined axes.

e0000b4c0e3e.text: Printed circuit board — the physical board that connects electronic components. A CAD layout is a board design, not proof that a board was manufactured.

ac06a928c7f2.text: A mammalian expression plasmid that carries inserted DNA and regulatory elements needed for expression in cultured cells.

f0d8ae18d3e0.text: Polydimethylsiloxane — a silicone polymer considered in transport models. It is not part of the current AeroSense assembly or required bill of materials.

e1e21fd24a02.text: An electronic component that converts incoming light into a small electrical current.

5075715743ac.text: Photocurrent produced per unit of incident optical power, usually expressed in amperes per watt. It depends on the wavelength of the light.

d3e39fb1be09.text: A circular DNA molecule used as a carrier for genes or other genetic elements in an experiment.

4275ce19b6c1.text: Projection neuron — a neuron that relays processed olfactory information from the antennal lobe to higher centers.

1a3ddda04b96.text: Proof of concept — an early demonstration that a core idea can work under defined conditions.

d50e4df1a28f.text: A DNA signal that directs formation of the 3′ end and poly(A) tail of a messenger RNA in a eukaryotic cell.

94526703ed4c.text: An iGEM BioBrick assembly standard. Compatibility with it must be checked independently of other standards.

648e66c50905.text: iGEM Registry assembly standard for composing BioBrick/RFC-compatible parts with defined prefix and suffix sites.

bfe9d37d5c03.text: A classification of biological agents by the relative risk they pose; institutional assignment must be confirmed locally.

ac175d221b50.text: A category such as low, medium, or high used to guide the next action; it is not a direct measurement of food safety.

3192134ac0b8.text: Serviceable available market — the part of TAM the product could realistically serve given its scope and geography.

fc7e58ddf673.text: A DNA sequencing method often used to verify a cloned sequence or junction.

babc5b9b6eb9.text: Successive-approximation analog-to-digital converter — a circuit that samples a voltage and resolves its digital value by successive comparisons.

e11f225772c7.text: An early check that identifies samples needing closer attention. A screening result is not a certified safety verdict.

6b5fa6531166.text: United Nations Sustainable Development Goal — a shared framework for describing social and environmental aims, not proof that an aim has been achieved.

81572438c3af.text: Safety Data Sheet — a supplier document describing chemical hazards, handling, and emergency information for a substance.

7acab3f1d3b2.text: In electronics, how strongly a device responds to a small input. In classification, the proportion of true positives correctly detected. The intended meaning needs context.

29806bbdfdc6.text: Spiking neural network — a neural model that communicates with discrete spike events over time.

8fa8e401bbe2.text: Signal-to-noise ratio — how large the useful signal is compared with unwanted variation or background.

761e7a893b92.text: Serviceable obtainable market — the share a team could plausibly capture within a stated period and sales plan.

3564ecb87980.text: Standard operating procedure — an institution-approved written method for performing a task safely and consistently.

4847efe3799d.text: A representation strategy in which only a small fraction of units are strongly active for a given input.

cf85808659df.text: In sensing, how selectively a system responds to a target. In classification, the proportion of true negatives correctly identified.

8e99c843a550.text: Serial Peripheral Interface — a synchronous serial bus commonly used between a microcontroller and peripherals such as ADCs.

bc283b484fd2.text: A preprocessing step that centers features and scales them by their training-set standard deviation; it must be fitted without test-set leakage.

ec1bb84f84fb.text: Spike-timing-dependent plasticity — a learning rule that changes connection strength based on the timing of neuron-like spikes.

e8a3b452fc45.text: A triangle-mesh file format commonly used to transfer a three-dimensional part to 3D-printing software. A printable model is not evidence of validated fit or function.

aad3bb6095aa.text: Support vector machine — a model that learns a boundary between classes from labeled examples.

dd0d495fecff.text: The time needed for a response to reach 90% of its final change. Gas-phase, liquid-phase, and biological response times describe different processes.

097de6d53445.text: Total addressable market — the broadest plausible market for a defined product, under stated assumptions.

14ce3ca66bcc.text: Transimpedance amplifier — a circuit that converts a small input current into a usable output voltage.

ea0daee41ef0.text: Universal asynchronous receiver-transmitter — a serial data interface. The AeroSense programming connection uses 3.3 V UART; it is separate from USB-C power.

84ddba53a876.text: Volatile organic compound — a carbon-containing chemical that readily enters the gas phase at ambient conditions.

a143ddde07b8.text: Voltage reference — a stable comparison voltage that helps an ADC convert an input signal into numbers.

7ece977eda83.text: A synthetic compound used to activate Orco-containing insect odorant-receptor channels; useful as a pathway control.

3a2b4e836640.text: How much a specified buyer would pay for a defined solution; it must be tested with the actual buyer, not inferred from general interest.

6c0cb7e9ba23.text: Relative fluorescence change — the change in fluorescence divided by a baseline fluorescence level.
